page.overview:
What is Grace Andersen Sanitarium?

Grace Andersen Sanitarium is a mental health facility and detainment center for the criminally insane that is located in California.

Sometime after October 31, 1998, Laurie Strode was sent here due to the fact that she was no longer stable, as she had unwittingly killed a man that she had thought was her brother.

Exactly three years after Halloween 1998, Laurie's homicidal brother, Michael Myers, tracked her down and murdered her after killing two security guards. He then went to another patient named Harold Trumble and handed him his knife, so that Harold would be seen as the culprit.
